entries.name: Stop
entries.description: Regulatory sign requiring a full stop before the stop line or junction.

entries.name: Give way
entries.description: Regulatory sign requiring drivers to yield to traffic on the major road.

entries.name: No entry
entries.description: Prohibits entry of all vehicles from this direction.

entries.name: One way
entries.description: Indicates that traffic on the road flows in one direction only.

entries.name: No parking
entries.description: Prohibits parking along the controlled section.

entries.name: No stopping
entries.description: Prohibits stopping or standing of vehicles along the controlled section.

entries.name: No overtaking
entries.description: Prohibits overtaking of motor vehicles.

entries.name: No U-turn
entries.description: Prohibits U-turns.

entries.name: Speed limit

speed.notes: The number shown is the posted legal limit from the sign. RVHL never infers it.

entries.description: Maximum legal speed in km/h on the road section that follows.

entries.name: Height restriction
entries.description: Prohibits vehicles exceeding the indicated height.

entries.name: Width restriction
entries.description: Prohibits vehicles exceeding the indicated width.

entries.name: Weight restriction
entries.description: Prohibits vehicles exceeding the indicated laden weight.

entries.name: Sharp left bend
entries.description: Warns of a sharp bend to the left.

entries.name: Sharp right bend
entries.description: Warns of a sharp bend to the right.

entries.name: Hairpin bend
entries.description: Warns of a hairpin bend requiring a large change of direction.

entries.name: Dangerous dip
entries.description: Warns of a sudden dip in the road profile.

entries.name: Speed breaker
entries.description: Warns of a speed breaker or hump ahead.

entries.name: Rough road
entries.description: Warns of an uneven or bumpy road surface.

entries.name: Loose gravel
entries.description: Warns of loose chippings or gravel that may be thrown up or reduce grip.

entries.name: Falling rocks
entries.description: Warns of a risk of rocks falling or lying on the road.

entries.name: Narrow bridge
entries.description: Warns of a bridge narrower than the approach road.

entries.name: Narrow road
entries.description: Warns that the carriageway ahead is narrow.

entries.name: Road narrows
entries.description: Warns that the carriageway narrows on one or both sides.

entries.name: Slippery road
entries.description: Warns of a surface that may be slippery.

entries.name: Crossroads
entries.description: Warns of a crossroad junction ahead.

entries.name: T-junction
entries.description: Warns of a T-intersection ahead.

entries.name: Y-junction
entries.description: Warns of a Y-intersection ahead.

entries.name: Roundabout
entries.description: Warns of a roundabout ahead.

entries.name: Pedestrian crossing
entries.description: Warns of a pedestrian crossing ahead.

entries.name: School ahead
entries.description: Warns of a school zone where children may cross.

entries.name: Cattle crossing
entries.description: Warns that cattle may cross or be on the road.

entries.name: Railway crossing
entries.description: Warns of a level crossing with a railway line.

entries.name: Hospital
entries.description: Informs of a hospital nearby; also indicates a zone needing quiet and care.

entries.name: Parking
entries.description: Indicates a designated parking area.

entries.name: Fuel
entries.description: Indicates a fuel station.

entries.name: Bus stop
entries.description: Indicates a bus stop; buses may stop and pedestrians gather.

entries.name: Destination and direction signs
entries.description: Directional guide signs showing destinations, routes and distances.
